document.abstract: Increasing use of film for color telecasting has emphasized the need for a more critical view of the capabilities of both the film and the TV system, and for a greater understanding of the colorimetric behavior of the combination. Film and TV picture requirements are considered introductory to the principles of improved masking techniques.
